description.value: Izba Bistro is a Polish and European restaurant in Port Coquitlam led by Chef Iwona, who draws on generations-old recipes to produce handmade perogies, schnitzel, and cabbage rolls. The bistro seats up to 40 guests and cultivates a warm, home-like atmosphere rooted in Polish hospitality. It uses fresh local ingredients alongside certified Angus beef and Oceanwise seafood.
